authority.rule: Package existence, qualification, admission, release, discovery, installation, engine compatibility and Host authority are independent claims.

guidance_scope.rule: This frozen projection describes v0.0.18 product capability only. It does not prove the product is the current released, discoverable or installable lifecycle stage.

type_position_authority.decision_rule: A type or feature is usable only at the exact admitted position below. WIT vocabulary, local values, Core lanes, Component profiles, Host bindings and public results are separate claims.
type_position_authority.alternative_rule: Alternatives must preserve semantics. Numeric width or signedness, async behavior, identity, ordering, ownership and failure semantics may change only with explicit application proof; otherwise stop.

function_shape.parameters: zero or more heterogeneous typed parameters

u64_ordinary_source.stop: WIT u64 or a physical i64 Core lane does not admit ordinary-source u64.
u64_ordinary_source.alternative: Use an exact qualified adapter that admits u64. Use u32 or i64 only after application-owned bounds and signedness prove equivalence; otherwise stop.
